description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing input/output data, specifically for unit testing in a C project. It includes functions to read file contents into a buffer and to print the contents of files and data buffers.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test utility memory structure.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file and/or a string of key-value pair data for debugging or testing output verification.
